widgetTool.name: show_bill_summary_card
widgetTool.description: Shows a bill or payment summary card on chat: amount, convenience fee, due date, confirmation number and the card by its last 4 digits only. Use it after a bill explanation or a payment when the caller is on chat. Values come only from tool results. No spoken pacing is needed. Call shape: name is always cx-show-bill-summary-card and all card fields go inside payload.

name.description: Always exactly cx-show-bill-summary-card (the card element this tool renders).

card_last4.description: Last 4 digits of the card; never a full number.

confirmation_number.description: Confirmation number from the payment tool.

convenience_fee.description: Convenience fee in dollars; omit when none.

display_text.description: Optional. The short on-screen text of the reply: one short sentence with the amount and the due date. The website shows it instead of the long spoken text. Dollar amounts and dates are written in bold markdown (**$12.50**, **November 7, 2026**). The card never repeats this text.

title.description: Card title, for example the bill period or payment confirmation.

payload.description: The card data. Put every card field inside this object.

textResponseConfig.textResponseInstruction: Write this text as the full spoken explanation, exactly as a person would say it on a phone call: plain natural spoken sentences, built only from the tool results and nothing invented, that say every fact the card shows once (the card is never repeated afterwards). Say every amount, percentage and date in words (for example forty-one dollars and one cent, the twenty-sixth of October), never digits, dollar signs or symbols, and say a year in words too (twenty twenty-six); a confirmation or claim number is the one exception and is read as returned in short groups. Use no emoji, markdown, bullets, tables, symbols or line breaks, because the voice may read this text aloud. Say the title, the amount, the convenience fee only when it is above zero, the due date, the confirmation number when there is one, and the last four digits of the card in words. The short on-screen text goes only in display_text of the card payload (always pass it, written in the customer's language; digits and symbols are allowed there): one short sentence with the amount and the due date, the confirmation number when there is one, and a fee only when it is above zero (the card shows the other rows). This text is the whole reply, so write no other text and no separate pacing sentence. When the tool call failed there is no card and the text stays short.
